class.name: IfcStructuralLinearAction
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a curve. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: Intermediate supertype IfcStructuralCurveAction inserted. Derived attribute PredefinedType added. NOTE Like its supertype IfcStructuralCurveAction , this action type may also act on curved edges.
